biological_support.statistical_interpretation: RNA shows a coherent inflammatory/immune-up pattern with large standardized mean differences and strong FDR control (26/50 pathways q<0.05). WXS shows nominal PBRM1 and VHL depletion in C0001 but no gene survives BH correction (0/22 q<0.05). CNV shows a coherent pattern of higher VHL/SETD2/PBRM1/chr20q and more chr14q loss and CDKN2A loss, with 19/49 continuous features and 5/107 gain/loss features significant at q<0.05. Effect sizes are moderate to large (|delta| 0.55-0.91 for top features), but WXS uncertainty is wide and FDR-nonsignificant.
biological_support.medical_interpretation: C0001 is characterized by relative up-regulation of inflammatory and IL6/JAK/STAT3 Hallmark programs and relative down-regulation of pancreas beta cells and heme metabolism. At the genomic level, C0001 shows lower PBRM1 and VHL mutation frequency and a distinct CNV profile including more chr14q loss and CDKN2A loss. These are descriptive molecular associations within the current comparison and do not establish a specific ccRCC subtype or clinical behavior.
limitations: WXS findings are not significant after BH correction.
RNA and CNV are from the same patient set and are not independent validation.
No external molecular taxonomy was evaluated.
Clinical characterization is not included as biological support.

cross_modal_consistency.statistical_interpretation: C0001 shows positive but small fixed-membership median silhouettes across all five modalities, with RNA and WXS relatively higher. Patient membership support is moderate (median 3 of 5 modalities positive) and no patient has zero positive modalities. The internal SNF probe is estimable with high fraction silhouette positive and moderate resampling stability (ARI 0.604), but very small silhouette values. The C0001-C0002 boundary is weak in the fused space (pair median silhouette 0.000242) and modest in RNA, WXS, and CNV. PERMANOVA R2 is small across modalities (0.013-0.031). PERMDISP is significant for WSI and CNV, indicating dispersion differences that complicate interpretation of separation.
cross_modal_consistency.medical_interpretation: The current partition has weak but consistently positive structural support across modalities, with RNA showing the strongest internal and boundary separation. The significant PERMDISP for WSI and CNV suggests that group differences may partly reflect dispersion rather than pure location separation. These structural metrics describe the current partition and do not independently validate biological subtype identity.
limitations: Silhouette values are very small.
Resampling was performed on the existing SNF affinity subgraph; modality affinities and SNF were not re-estimated.
Negative PCoA eigenvalues were discarded; PERMDISP is an approximate diagnostic.
Structural characterization does not independently validate biological subtype identity.

reports.statistical_interpretation: C0002 shows positive but small fixed-membership median silhouettes in CT, WSI, RNA, WXS, and CNV, with RNA and CNV relatively higher and CT/WXS very small. Patient membership support is moderate (median 3 of 5 modalities positive) and no patient has zero positive modalities. The internal SNF probe is estimable with high fraction silhouette positive and moderate resampling stability (ARI 0.590), but very small silhouette values. The C0002-C0001 boundary is weak in the fused space and modest in RNA, WXS, and CNV. PERMANOVA R2 is small across modalities. PERMDISP is significant for WSI and CNV, indicating dispersion differences.
reports.medical_interpretation: The current partition has weak but consistently positive structural support across modalities, with RNA and CNV showing the strongest internal separation for C0002. The significant PERMDISP for WSI and CNV suggests that group differences may partly reflect dispersion rather than pure location separation. These structural metrics describe the current partition and do not independently validate biological subtype identity.
limitations: Silhouette values are very small.
Resampling was performed on the existing SNF affinity subgraph; modality affinities and SNF were not re-estimated.
Negative PCoA eigenvalues were discarded; PERMDISP is an approximate diagnostic.
Structural characterization does not independently validate biological subtype identity.

reports.medical_interpretation: The current partition is not a simple echo of TCGA stage or grade. Low overlap does not establish molecular novelty and does not evaluate published molecular ccRCC subtype taxonomies, which were not assessed in the current data.
limitations: Only TCGA stage and grade labels are assessable.
